result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, truncated text on partially visible cards/chips, and a cut-off category filter chip at the screen edge.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side (same image, same 15–25 min badge, same €0.90 delivery), which looks like a data duplication bug.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list on the backend/client before rendering so each venue appears only once in the carousel.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped and its title is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' without an ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add text truncation with an ellipsis (…) and consider a slight peek/padding or fade to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: A sixth category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge with no visible label, appearing as an empty gray sliver.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible chips show at least part of their label, or add a gradient/fade edge to indicate the row scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: The green promo banner has faint circular decorative shapes on the right side that overlap the edge and look like a rendering artifact rather than intentional decoration.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative circles cleanly within the banner's rounded corners or adjust their opacity/positioning so they read as deliberate design.
